note: Literature magnetic Feshbach parameters for elastic a(B)=a_bg(1−Δ/(B−B0)) in the aa channel |3,+3>+|3,+3| (absolute ground state). High-field s-wave poles and zeros from Berninger et al., PRA 87, 032517 (2013) [arXiv:1212.5584v2] M2012 (Tables 2 & 4). Low-field Chin RMP Table IV values updated with M2012 B0=−12.38 G. Δ for high-field s-waves taken as B_zero−B_pole from Table 2. Cs has many overlapping d/g/i resonances; only the main s-waves plus a few well-characterized higher-ℓ lines are listed. Isolated Chin form is approximate when resonances overlap.
a_bg_ref: Berninger et al. PRA 87, 032517 (2013) Table 4 — M2012 triplet scattering length a_T=2858(19) a0. Local a_bg on each resonance may differ (Chin RMP quotes 1720 a0 for the low-field s-wave).

resonances.label: s-wave -12.38 G
resonances.ref: Berninger Table 4 s-pole −12.38(8) G; zero crossing 17.12 G (Table 2) → Δ≈29.5 G. Chin RMP Table IV had B0=−11.7 G, Δ=28.7 G, a_bg=1720 a0. Controls a(B) for B≳0 (Cs BEC / Efimov near ~8–20 G).

resonances.label: d-wave 47.97 G

resonances.ref: Berninger Table 4 — −6(34)7s(6) pole 548.78(9) G; zero near 556.26 G (Table 2) → Δ≈7.48 G. Open-channel dominated; overlaps g-wave near 554 G.
